const far = [{ x: 200, y: 0 }, { x: 280, y: 0 }, { x: 280, y: 40 }, { x: 200, y: 40 }];
console.log('走线远离另一区域：', eda.sys_Math.intersects(trace, far));

const small = [{ x: 20, y: 20 }, { x: 60, y: 20 }, { x: 60, y: 50 }, { x: 20, y: 50 }];
console.log('小区域整体在走线范围内：', eda.sys_Math.intersects(trace, small));

_source.title: 判断两个多边形是否相交
_source.remarks.text.0: 判断两个多边形的区域是否有任何重叠（包括包含、部分相交、边界接触）
_source.example.text.0: 1. 部分重叠的两个矩形 → true
_source.example.text.2: 3. 完全包含也是相交的一种 → true
_source.example.text.3: 4. 仅边界贴合同样算相交 → true

title: Determine whether two polygons intersect
remarks.text.0: Determine whether the regions of two polygons have any overlap (including containment, partial intersection, and boundary contact)
